---
request: Market entry brief for selling our backup appliance to mid-size hospitals in Brazil.
---
Recommendation

Conditional go: enter in 2027 if a local distributor with ANVISA experience signs before Q2.

Market size

TAM is $420 million a year (industry report); SAM, mid-size private hospitals, is $95 million (industry report); SOM in three years is $6 million (our estimate from the distributor's reach).

| Segment | Buyers | Annual spend | Our fit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Private mid-size hospitals | 1,100 | $95 million | High |
| Public hospitals | 2,400 | $210 million | Low |

Competitors

Two incumbents sell through system integrators: one global vendor and one local reseller of refurbished units.

Regulation

Medical data must stay in Brazil under LGPD; appliances that store patient records need local support contracts.

What would change this

A distributor refusing exclusivity; a change in LGPD data-residency rules; the local reseller cutting prices below $40,000 per unit.

Next steps

Sales lead to shortlist three distributors by 15 November; legal to confirm LGPD hosting terms by 30 November.
